title_zh: 核对舞台提示并标记换场时刻

scenario.label_zh: 确认节目概要中的准确换场提示
scenario.goal_zh: 区分整场概述与具体提示，确认掌声结束后用灯光信号提示主持人上场

context_zh: 舞台经理与灯光员在演出前核对提示表。
author: author-phase08-c

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: This outline gives me the order of the acts, but I need a more precise cue for the host's return.

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: The final chord isn't the cue. Wait until the applause has finished.

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: What will prompt the host to walk back on?

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Your small blue light beside the curtain. The host can see it from the wings.

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: So precisely when the applause ends, I switch on that light?

sentences.speaker: Victor
sentences.text: Yes. Don't bring up the main stage lights until the host has reached the microphone.

sentences.speaker: Mae
sentences.text: I've marked both cues separately. Let's try that transition once.
